page.intro: A new door opens every day until Christmas. Behind each one is a small puzzle task to do that day. Do every door on its day to stay perfect.
page.ended: The advent challenge has finished. Thanks for playing!
page.how1: Open each day's door and do the task that day to stay perfect.
page.how2: Missed a door? You can catch up until {date}. It won't count towards perfect, but it counts towards your award.
page.how3: You can't fail. The more doors you do, the better your award.
